items.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
items.summary: OpenAI is facing a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states that accuse the company of harming children and misleading customers about the safety of ChatGPT, as reported earlier by Reuters.
